verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a SaaS security and compliance platform, so letting users opt out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair axis for it. The evidence pack contains no documentation of any telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. Related controls such as deleting the AWS role, RBAC scoping and MDM settings govern access or device policy, not the product's own telemetry, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
